definitions.explanation: The physical space between lines of text in writing or printing.
The unstated or hidden meaning in text or speech, similar to 'reading between the lines' in English.

examples.japanese: {行間|ぎょうかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{広|ひろ}げる→広げる：01981_hirogeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{読|よ}み→読む：00426_yomu⟧やすく⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Widening the line spacing makes it easier to read.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦フォント→フォント：20915_fonto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{行間|ぎょうかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{狭|せま}くて→狭い：00750_semai⟧⟦{読|よ}み→読む：00426_yomu⟧にくい。
examples.english: This font has narrow line spacing and is hard to read.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{行間|ぎょうかん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{不満|ふまん}→不満：02497_fuman⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{伝|つた}わって→伝わる：01961_tsutawaru⟧きた。

notes:
Composed of ⟦{行|ぎょう}→行：26669_gyou⟧ (line/row) + ⟦{間|かん}→〜間：28469_kan⟧ (space/between).

SENSE 1 — LINE SPACING:
Used in publishing, word processing, and design.
- {行間|ぎょうかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{広|ひろ}げる→広げる：01981_hirogeru⟧: to widen line spacing
- {行間|ぎょうかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{詰|つ}める→詰める：02078_tsumeru⟧: to tighten line spacing
- {行間|ぎょうかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設定|せってい}→設定：04767_settei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to set line spacing

SENSE 2 — IMPLIED MEANING:
Figurative, meaning the unstated implications behind words.
- {行間|ぎょうかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧: to read between the lines
- {行間|ぎょうかん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{読|よ}み{取|と}る→読み取る：04602_yomitoru⟧: to infer from between the lines

This figurative sense is especially important in Japanese culture, where indirect communication is valued.
